description: Project phases and milestones: the `:::timeline` block draws bars and markers on a time axis — phases written in the block, or the consolidated planning of the pages below. A feature, not an app: a planning hangs off whichever page has a reason to carry one.

project-status.label: Project status
project-status.help: How the project is GOING, and only while it is under way — a project waiting or closed says that instead.

subproject.description: The sub-projects below this page, each with where it stands — its `project-status` while it is under way, its lifecycle status when that has something more urgent to say.

timeline.description: Phases and milestones on a time axis — written as list lines in the block, or read from the start:/due: of the pages below.
